'''Kor Gorensla''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Gorensla/Legends|Gorensla]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].

==Description==
Kor Gorensla was a ringed, [[Color/Legends|deep green]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by six mid-sized [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and fifteen large [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. These [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] were all heavily [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]], which provided a variety of environments for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] of the [[Gorensla/Legends|Gorensla]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==History==
Kor Gorensla served as the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the Gorensla kajidic. At first, the Gorensla established their estates on [[Gorensla Hutta]], the largest moon of Kor Gorensla. However, over time, important estates were also built on all of the other moons and asteroids that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="LoNH" />

The Gorensla estates were filled with ancient, exotic wares from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. These valuable items represented great investments for the Hutts of Gorensla, as they often stored them in the hopes of revealing them [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] or [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later to make a tidy profit.<ref name="LoNH" />
